title: Home practical guide and safety card: sound investigation
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 23 (Home practical guide and safety card: sound investigation (portal worksheet; adult present for glass))
intro: Lesson 23: Investigation: how can we change a sound? (test and record). A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To carry out your sound investigation fairly
equipment: The kit on your plan sheet
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Set up your kit exactly as your plan says
Change only the one thing you chose
Write a conclusion: when I ... the sound ...

questions.q: Big question: what should a scientist do if results disagree?
questions.a: Find what changed and repeat the test.
